headline: Record revenue on Cu prices; Florence ramps into production
summary_short: Q2 2026 record revenue CAD 331M and EPS CAD $0.08 beat consensus by 14%. Gibraltar delivered 32 Mlbs Cu; Florence's first full quarter added 5 Mlbs. C1 at Florence $4.72/lb transitional.
summary_long: Taseko posted record Q2 2026 revenue of CAD 331M driven by strong copper prices and steady Gibraltar production. Adjusted EBITDA CAD 125M; operating cash flow CAD 183M. Copper sold: 37 Mlbs total (32 Gibraltar + 5.3 Florence). Florence Copper delivered its first full production quarter with >5 Mlbs Cu cathode; C1 cash cost of $4.72/lb is transitional as fixed costs spread over ramping volume. FY2026 Gibraltar guidance of 110-115 Mlbs Cu reaffirmed, supported by strong molybdenum by-product credits and favorable treatment charges. EPS CAD $0.08 beat the CAD $0.07 consensus by 14%.
confidence_notes: Florence Cu cost of $4.72/lb is transitional (first-quarter-of-production fixed-cost absorption). Real steady-state cost expected mid-$2/lb range once ramp completes. Source is a public earnings-call summary — verified against Taseko's own quarterly disclosures at globenewswire.com.
